notes:
- Automatic memory profiles for smaller graphics cards: tiled image processing
  on 8 GB cards, with smaller tiles and CPU prompt encoding on 4 GB cards.
  4 GB support is experimental; start with Draft and AI upscaling off.
- Fixed Normal memory mode preventing the image engine from starting. Larger
  cards retain their standard workflows and output settings.
- Chat can use a shorter conversation window on small cards. Model suggestions
  now consider installed files, and image-to-chat switching waits for memory
  to be released before deciding whether the image engine must stop.
- Added resolution guidance for small cards and bounded local engine logs to
  help diagnose startup failures and memory problems.
